node.title: Heavy-ruling rational branch has a degree-eleven exception split pencil
node.closure: the twenty anchor supports compile to a coprime affine pencil of pairwise-disjoint split exception locators, separated from the rational denominator
node.statement: In the rational output of the triple-owner heavy-ruling packet, let H_0 be the residual anchor pair core and write e=m'-|H_0|. Pair noncontainment and the low-pair margin give 1<=e<=11. Every one of the at least 20 anchor supports is the disjoint union H_0 union E_gamma, where |E_gamma|=e and the E_gamma are pairwise disjoint. If L_0 and L_{E_gamma} are their monic locators, then the rational certificate factors uniquely as A'-Qa_0'=L_0u and B'-Qb_0'=L_0v with deg u,deg v<=e, and u+gamma v=(c_0+c_1 gamma)L_{E_gamma}. The affine scalar is nonzero at every anchor slope, gcd(u,v)=1, max(deg u,deg v)=e, and every L_{E_gamma} is a pairwise-coprime split divisor of the residual domain locator. Moreover gcd(Q,L_0)=1 because a denominator root on H_0 would be a common pole. Thus the rational branch contains an exact degree-1-through-11, at-least-20-fiber split-pencil instance. No split-pencil census, rational payment, or MCA closure is claimed.
